rows.question: Show the gene symbol and the description of cancer biomarkers with panel = 'false'
rows.pred_sql:
WITH biomarker_core AS (
  SELECT
    b.id AS id,
    NULLIF(trim(b.gene_symbol), '') AS gene_symbol,
    NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(b.biomarker_description, b.biomarker_id)), '') AS biomarker_description,
    NULLIF(trim(be.biomarker_type), '') AS biomarker_type,
    b.test_is_a_panel AS test_is_a_panel
  FROM biomarker b
  LEFT JOIN biomarker_edrn be
    ON be.id = b.id
)
SELECT gene_symbol,
       biomarker_description
FROM biomarker_core
WHERE test_is_a_panel = false
  AND biomarker_type ILIKE '%cancer%'
ORDER BY gene_symbol ASC

rows.question: Show me all biomarkers on the EDRN platform which are not of type protein.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH biomarker_edrn_by_anatomy AS (
SELECT
  biomarker_edrn.uberon_anatomical_id AS uberon_anatomical_id,
  biomarker_edrn.biomarker_type AS biomarker_type,
  COUNT(*)::bigint AS biomarker_count
FROM
  biomarker_edrn
GROUP BY
  biomarker_edrn.uberon_anatomical_id,
  biomarker_edrn.biomarker_type
),
biomarker_edrn_type_normalized AS (
SELECT
  id,
  biomarker_title,
  -- canonicalize biomarker_type: trim whitespace, lower-case, map common variants to normalized categories
  -- lift literal mappings out: (see mapping rules below in metadata)
  CASE
    WHEN biomarker_type IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE
      -- trim surrounding whitespace and convert to lower-case for pattern matching
      (
        CASE
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) IN ('protein', 'protein biomarker', 'protein-coding') THEN 'protein'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) IN ('rna', 'mrna', 'micro rna', 'mirna', 'micro-rna', 'micro_rna') THEN 'rna'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) IN ('dna', 'genomic', 'genetic', 'genomic alteration') THEN 'dna'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) IN ('metabolite', 'metabolic') THEN 'metabolite'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) IN ('imaging', 'radiology', 'radiographic') THEN 'imaging'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) IN ('lipid', 'lipid marker') THEN 'lipid'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) IN ('epigenetic', 'methylation') THEN 'epigenetic'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) IN ('cellular', 'cell-based') THEN 'cellular'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) IN ('unknown', 'other', 'n/a', '') THEN 'other'
          ELSE lower(trim(biomarker_type))
        END
      )
  END AS biomarker_type_normalized,
  qa_state,
  uberon_anatomical_id,
  phase
FROM biomarker_edrn
),
edrn_biomarker_rows AS (
SELECT
  id AS biomarker_title,
  qa_state,
  phase,
  id,
  uberon_anatomical_id,
  biomarker_type
FROM biomarker_edrn
)
SELECT
  id,
  biomarker_title,
  biomarker_type,
  qa_state,
  uberon_anatomical_id,
  phase
FROM edrn_biomarker_rows
WHERE biomarker_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'protein'
ORDER BY id

rows.question: Identify a list of genes expressed in lung cancer
rows.pred_sql:
WITH differential_expression_by_doid_gene AS (
  SELECT
    de.gene_symbol,
    de.doid,
    de.log2fc,
    de.adjpvalue,
    de.pvalue,
    de.expression_change_direction,
    de.statistical_significance,
    de.subjects_total
  FROM differential_expression de
  WHERE
    -- only keep rows that indicate expression evidence
    de.expression_change_direction IS NOT NULL
    OR de.log2fc IS NOT NULL
),
disease_normalized_names AS (
  SELECT
    d.id,
    d.name,
    lower(trim(d.name)) AS name_lower
  FROM disease d
),
healthy_expression_by_gene_anatomy AS (
  SELECT
    he.ensembl_gene_id,
    he.uberon_anatomical_id,
    he.expression_level_gene_relative,
    he.expression_level_anatomical_relative,
    he.expression_score,
    he.expression_rank_score,
    he.call_quality
  FROM healthy_expression he
  WHERE
    -- only keep rows that indicate expression evidence
    he.expression_level_gene_relative IS NOT NULL
    OR he.expression_score IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  de.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  'differential_expression' AS source_table,
  -- evidence fields from differential_expression
  jsonb_build_object(
    'log2fc', de.log2fc,
    'adjpvalue', de.adjpvalue,
    'pvalue', de.pvalue,
    'expression_change_direction', de.expression_change_direction,
    'statistical_significance', de.statistical_significance,
    'subjects_total', de.subjects_total
  ) AS evidence_fields,
  de.doid AS disease_id_or_doid,
  dn.name AS disease_name
FROM differential_expression_by_doid_gene de
JOIN disease_normalized_names dn
  ON de.doid = dn.id
WHERE dn.name_lower LIKE '%lung%'
UNION ALL
SELECT
  xg.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  'healthy_expression' AS source_table,
  -- evidence fields from healthy_expression (aggregate per gene)
  jsonb_build_object(
    'uberon_anatomical_id(s)', jsonb_agg(DISTINCT heb.uberon_anatomical_id),
    'expression_level_gene_relative', jsonb_agg(DISTINCT heb.expression_level_gene_relative),
    'expression_level_anatomical_relative', jsonb_agg(DISTINCT heb.expression_level_anatomical_relative),
    'max_expression_score', MAX(heb.expression_score),
    'expression_rank_scores', jsonb_agg(DISTINCT heb.expression_rank_score),
    'call_qualities', jsonb_agg(DISTINCT heb.call_quality)
  ) AS evidence_fields,
  NULL::bigint AS disease_id_or_doid,
  NULL::character varying AS disease_name
FROM healthy_expression_by_gene_anatomy heb
JOIN xref_gene_ensembl xg
  ON heb.ensembl_gene_id = xg.ensembl_gene_id
WHERE heb.uberon_anatomical_id ILIKE '%lung%'
GROUP BY xg.gene_symbol
ORDER BY gene_symbol

rows.question: What is the test trade name for FDA tests which are actually used for predisposition?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH fda_tests_rowlevel AS (
SELECT
  test_trade_name,
  test_submission,
  test_manufacturer,
  test_approval_status,
  platform_method,
  clinical_significance,
  test_number_genes
FROM biomarker_fda_test
),
fda_test_use_rows AS (
SELECT
  bfu.id AS id,
  bfu.test_trade_name AS test_trade_name,
  bfu.test_submission AS test_submission,
  bfu.approved_indication AS approved_indication,
  bfu.actual_use AS actual_use
FROM biomarker_fda_test_use bfu
),
fda_tests_with_use AS (
SELECT
  bfu.id::bigint AS id,
  bfu.test_trade_name,
  bfu.test_submission,
  f.test_manufacturer,
  bfu.approved_indication,
  bfu.actual_use,
  f.test_approval_status
FROM biomarker_fda_test_use bfu
LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda_test f
  ON (bfu.test_trade_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.test_trade_name)
  AND (bfu.test_submission IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.test_submission)
)
SELECT DISTINCT ftr.test_trade_name AS test_trade_name
FROM fda_test_use_rows fur
JOIN fda_tests_rowlevel ftr
  ON fur.test_trade_name = ftr.test_trade_name
 AND fur.test_submission = ftr.test_submission
WHERE fur.actual_use IS NOT NULL
  AND lower(fur.actual_use) LIKE '%predisposition%'
ORDER BY test_trade_name ASC
